test_cases.name: smoke_path_order
test_cases.input: Stand up Engram Cloud smoke on localhost and sync a project
assertions: Uses docker compose then cloud config then enroll then sync --cloud --project
Does not recommend INSECURE_NO_AUTH on a public hostname
Treats local SQLite as source of truth

test_cases.name: dashboard_empty
test_cases.input: Dashboard shows 0 observations but mem_search finds ember-family rows
assertions: Does not delete or reset local SQLite
Runs cloud status, doctor, and sync --cloud --status
Explains cloud has not accepted pending journal

test_cases.name: policy_forbidden
assertions: Points at ENGRAM_CLOUD_ALLOWED_PROJECTS and managed grants
Does not claim the client can print the server allowlist

test_cases.name: gzip_x1f
test_cases.input: push fails with invalid character \x1f looking for beginning of value
assertions: Identifies gzip envelope vs JSON decode
Tells operator to preserve Content-Type and upgrade server if old
